item.title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Compute | Multiple Regions | 68cc9191
item.description:
Jul2316:23 UTC
Resolved - We confirm that the issue with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) service resources, caused by the global issue affecting CrowdStrike Falcon software, has been mitigated. We encourage any affected customers to review CrowdStrike's Statement on Falcon Content Update for Windows Hosts: (https://www.crowdstrike.com/falcon-content-update-remediation-and-guidance-hub/), which contains additional details and potential workaround steps.

Customer Impact: After extended monitoring, we can confirm that the services have been restored. If you are still experiencing issues or have any questions not addressed by the linked statement above, please reach out to Oracle Support by creating a service request (SR) and provide the reference number included in this notification.

Further updates will be provided as events warrant.

Reference Number: 68cc9191

Jul1919:55 UTC
Monitoring - We are aware that some customers are experiencing issues with their Oracle Cloud Infrastructure service resources due to the global issue affecting CrowdStrike Falcon software.
